settings.heading: What we publish, and what we don't.
settings.body:
The values above are the ones we specify. You will not find flow rates, load ratings or standards-compliance claims on this page, because we do not publish figures we cannot stand behind.

If your project needs a figure that isn't here, ask us. We will either give you the number or tell you we don't have it.
